summary: Tested 3 calendar & settings fixes for ERP Kora OS. All fixes verified working: (1) fetchData with org params, (2) Calendar shows posts with created_at when no scheduled_at/posted_at, (3) Pillar stats mini-report above calendar. Backend: 8/8 tests PASSED. Frontend: All features verified via Playwright.

issues: Console warnings about duplicate React keys in account/pillar rendering - non-blocking but should be addressed

critical_code_review_comments: Backend calendar query correctly uses $or condition with created_at fallback when scheduled_at/posted_at are null
Pillar stats endpoint aggregates posts by pillar_id and status, returns structured data with pillar metadata
Frontend getPostsForDay function correctly implements created_at fallback logic
fetchData in save/delete handlers now correctly passes org params (isOwnOrg ? null : selectedOrgId)
Minor: React key warnings in console for duplicate keys - should add unique identifiers
seed_data_creation: Test posts created and cleaned up during pytest (TEST_CALENDAR_* prefixed)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Calendar fixes fully tested. Backend calendar endpoint includes created_at in query. Pillar stats endpoint at /api/demand-studio/social/calendar/pillar-stats returns monthly breakdown by pillar with status counts. Frontend calendar shows pillar stats chips with data-testid='calendar-pillar-stats'. Settings CRUD works with org_id parameter.

calendar_created_at_fallback.description: Posts without scheduled_at/posted_at now appear on their created_at date in calendar
tests: test_calendar_returns_posts_without_scheduled_at - Creates post without scheduled_at, verifies it appears in calendar
test_calendar_query_or_condition - Verifies calendar returns posts with different date types
test_pillar_stats_endpoint_exists - Endpoint returns 200 with correct structure
test_pillar_stats_structure - Validates total_posts, pillars array, by_status breakdown

pillar_stats_frontend.description: Calendar view shows pillar mini-report chips above grid
verified: Displays pillar name, total count, and status breakdown (prod/edit/queue)

settings_fetchdata_fix.description: fetchData called with correct org params in all save/delete handlers
verified_in_frontend: Settings tab loads correct org data
Content Pillars section shows 2 pillars (Test Pillar, Food Porn)
Social Accounts shows 7 accounts (4 Mine, 3 Shared)
Audiences and Segments sections load correctly

tests: test_calendar_posts_with_scheduled_at_still_work - Posts with scheduled_at appear on correct date
test_pillar_crud_with_org_id_regression - Pillar CRUD with org_id parameter works

api_verification.GET /api/demand-studio/social/calendar: 200 OK - Returns posts matching scheduled_at, posted_at, or created_at (when no schedule)
api_verification.GET /api/demand-studio/social/calendar/p: 200 OK - Returns pillar breakdown with totals and status counts

bugs_verified_fixed.fix: fetchData now called with (isOwnOrg ? null : selectedOrgId) in handleSavePillar, handleDeletePillar, etc.
bugs_verified_fixed.verified: Settings page shows correct pillars/accounts for selected org

bugs_verified_fixed.verified: Posts without scheduled_at appear in calendar on their created_at date

bugs_verified_fixed.bug: Calendar needs mini-report by pillar per month
